title: 🤰 Pregnancy & Postpartum Ayurveda in India
h1: Natural Care for Mothers and Babies
intro: Ayurveda offers time-tested care for women during pregnancy, childbirth, and postpartum recovery. By using herbal remedies, gentle therapies, yoga, and diet support, Ayurveda helps expectant mothers stay healthy, ensures safe delivery, and supports faster recovery after childbirth. For postpartum mothers, Ayurvedic care focuses on healing the body, balancing hormones, restoring energy, and supporting lactation — while also caring for the newborn’s health.

sections.heading: Benefits of Pregnancy & Postpartum Ayurveda
points: Promotes a healthy pregnancy & safe delivery
Reduces nausea, back pain & pregnancy discomforts
Strengthens immunity & prevents complications
Accelerates postpartum recovery & wound healing
Improves lactation & nutrition for baby
Balances hormones, mood & emotional health
Prevents long-term issues like back pain & weakness

sections.heading: Ayurvedic Care During Pregnancy
points: Garbhini Paricharya (Pregnancy Care Routine): Month-by-month Ayurvedic care
Prenatal Yoga & Meditation: Enhances flexibility, reduces stress & prepares for delivery
Herbal Support: Safe herbs for digestion, immunity & strength
Special Diet Plans: Nutrition for both mother & baby

sections.heading: Postpartum Ayurveda (Sutika Paricharya)
points: Abhyanga (Oil Massage): Relieves back pain, relaxes muscles & improves circulation
Herbal Steam Therapy: Aids recovery & removes toxins
Rasayana (Rejuvenation Therapy): Herbal tonics for energy & immunity
Hormonal Balance Therapies: Restores natural balance after childbirth
Infant Ayurvedic Care: Gentle oil massages & natural immunity boosters for newborns

sections.heading: Why Choose Ayurveda for Mother & Baby Care in India?
points: Safe & natural, no chemical medicines
Personalized care by certified Ayurveda doctors
Affordable wellness packages compared to abroad
Combines traditional wisdom with modern maternal care
Available in Kerala, Goa, Rishikesh & leading wellness centers

sections.heading: Cost of Pregnancy & Postpartum Ayurveda Programs
points: 1-Week Program: $250 – $400
2-Week Recovery Program: $500 – $750
3-Week Complete Care Program: $850 – $1,200
sections.note: Includes consultations, therapies, herbal medicines & accommodation.
